plan: Given my private value of $8, I aim to bid slightly above half my value to balance potential profit and risk of overbidding. Rational bidders will likely bid near their values, but since winning requires paying the third-highest bid, I must not overbid. I will bid $4.1 to increase my chances of winning while ensuring I pay less than my value if successful. This strategy maximizes potential profit while minimizing loss risks in this one-time round.

Given my value of $32, I'll bid slightly above the expected average value to maximize profit while minimizing the risk of overbidding. Assuming uniform distribution, the average value is $24.5. I will bid $25.5 to increase my chances of winning without exceeding my value of $32. This bid should be competitive against rational bidders aiming for profit without overpaying.

Given my value of $38, I will aim to bid slightly below this value to maximize potential profit while minimizing overpayment. Since the third-highest bid determines the cost, I will bid $37.9 to slightly undercut my value, ensuring I win if others bid lower. This strategy balances winning probability and profit maximization, considering rational bidders will also aim to maximize their payoffs.
